toolCalling.title: Tool Calling
toolCalling.description: Translates OpenAI tool calling onto every upstream wire: the default chat wire is fully managed (prompt injection plus response parsing), OpenCode speaks its envelope protocol, and the remaining wires pass tools natively.

modeHints.off: No prompt injection, no response parsing. The default chat wire never forwards native tools upstream, so client tool requests have no effect in this mode.
modeHints.auto: The managed protocol runs automatically whenever a request carries tools and the wire does not handle tools itself.
modeHints.force: Force the managed flow even when a provider profile does not declare managed support (self-managed wires such as OpenCode are unaffected).

clients.standardOpenAiToolsDesc: Use this for generic OpenAI-compatible clients and SDKs.
clients.cherryStudioMcpDesc: Use this for Cherry Studio MCP tools. Exact MCP tool names are preserved.

steps.1: The client sends tools / tool_choice in OpenAI format.
steps.2: The engine strips the native fields and injects the tool catalogue as ModelPort XML into the system prompt; required or a forced tool adds a directive, and parallel_tool_calls: false limits the turn to a single call.
steps.3: The model answers with XML markup; streaming and non-streaming responses are parsed back into OpenAI tool_calls with ids like call_<requestId>-<n>.
steps.4: When tool_choice: required was declared but the model did not call, the response carries X-ModelPort-Tool-Violation: required; unparseable markup is stripped while the surrounding text is preserved.

rows.chatManaged: Default chat wire (aggregate openai-chat entries, custom providers)

details.chatManaged: Managed XML: prompt injection plus response parsing; native tools are never forwarded upstream
details.opencode: The envelope protocol is translated by the runtime itself; the managed layer only decides tool_choice / parallel limits
details.accountChannels: Native tools round-trip through the gateway with inbound history pre-validation
details.anthropic: Native mapping between tool_use and OpenAI tool_calls
details.responses: Native Responses tools; no injection, so the tool description is never doubled

compression.title: Context compression
compression.enableHint: Compresses only the newest turn (tool output and user input) and leaves all history bytes untouched, so the upstream prompt cache is preserved. With it off, requests are byte-for-byte unchanged.
compression.aggressivenessHint: Stronger settings keep fewer rows. Error rows, statistical outliers and numeric anomalies are never dropped at any strength.

outputSteering.title: Output verbosity
outputSteering.enableHint: Affects the model's output only: appends a fixed instruction block to the tail of the system prompt to skip preambles and postambles and stop restating code or tool output. The block text is fixed per level, so it never breaks the upstream prompt cache; with it off, requests are byte-for-byte unchanged.
outputSteering.levelHint: Higher levels are stricter. No level ever drops what the task needs to be correct (negations, conditions, constraints) — it only shortens how it is said.
